prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Tyler. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — a couple quick clarifying questions first so my suggestions fit you:

1) Which “Tyler” do you mean (Tyler, TX, or a different city named Tyler)?  
2) What type of tanning do you want: spray/airbrush (sunless), UV / tanning beds, or do you want options for both?  
3) Any other preferences: budget, distance from a particular neighborhood, experience level (first time vs regular), or skin/health concerns (very fair skin, on photosensitizing meds)?

If you want recommendations right away, I can also give a short list of the kinds of salons to call plus exactly what to ask and what to avoid. Which would you like?
